goal:
Implement cursor.nvim per the repository implementation plan.

The planner authored IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md on the base branch with the v0.1 scope, architecture, public API, file layout, and acceptance criteria. Workers must read that file at the start of their run and treat it as the source of truth for what cursor.nvim is. The repo description on GitHub ("A NeoVIM extension for the Cursor SDK") is the only other authoritative context; everything else is in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.
summary: ship cursor.nvim v0.1: a Neovim plugin wrapping the cursor-agent CLI
acceptanceCriteria: cursor.nvim v0.1 ships with setup, :CursorChat, :CursorAsk, :CursorStop, :CursorStatus, and :checkhealth cursor
stylua and luacheck pass on all Lua sources
GitHub Actions CI exists and runs lint + tests on push and PR
doc/cursor.txt and README.md cover installation, configuration, and commands
All worker branches merge cleanly into a single deliverable branch suitable for an opt-in PR against main

tasks.name: core-plugin
tasks.scopedGoal: Build the base cursor.nvim plugin per IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md (read it from the repo root before doing anything else). Produce: plugin/cursor.lua, lua/cursor/init.lua, lua/cursor/config.lua, lua/cursor/health.lua, lua/cursor/agent.lua, doc/cursor.txt, README.md, .stylua.toml, .luacheckrc, .gitignore additions for Lua. Implement setup(), ask(), chat() (stub that calls into ui.chat — leave the UI module to chat-ui worker but expose the seam), stop(), status(). Implement the cursor-agent subprocess wrapper in lua/cursor/agent.lua: spawn via vim.fn.jobstart, parse stream-json line-by-line with vim.json.decode wrapped in pcall, dispatch on the `type` field, surface assistant text to a callback. Implement health.lua using vim.health (ok/warn/error). Register :CursorChat, :CursorAsk, :CursorStop, :CursorStatus in plugin/cursor.lua with `vim.api.nvim_create_user_command`. Write README.md with lazy.nvim / packer / vim-plug snippets and the setup() shape. Write doc/cursor.txt as proper :help with a tag line. Do NOT touch lua/cursor/ui/* — that belongs to chat-ui. Do NOT add tests or CI — that belongs to tests-and-ci. Push your branch and report it in the handoff.
acceptance: require('cursor').setup({}) returns without error in a headless Neovim
lua/cursor/agent.lua exposes start({prompt, on_chunk, on_done, on_error}) and stop() and parses stream-json defensively
lua/cursor/health.lua produces structured vim.health output for cursor-agent presence and version
README.md and doc/cursor.txt cover installation, setup, commands
tasks.verify:
## Setup
- nvim --headless -c "set rtp+=$(pwd)" -c "lua require('cursor').setup({})" -c "q"

## Automated
- stylua --check lua/ plugin/ should pass
- luacheck lua/ plugin/ should pass (with .luacheckrc)

## Manual
- nvim --headless +':checkhealth cursor' +'q' produces lines starting with cursor:
- :CursorAsk 'ping' with cursor-agent stubbed to 'cat <<<\"{\\"type\\":\\"assistant\\",\\"text\\":\\"hi\\"}\"\n' renders 'hi' into a buffer

## Gotchas
- Use vim.schedule for any vim.api call inside on_stdout/on_stderr.
- pcall every vim.json.decode; the CLI may emit blank lines or partial chunks at boundary.

tasks.name: chat-ui
tasks.scopedGoal: Build the chat UI for cursor.nvim on top of the core-plugin's agent.lua. Read IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and the upstream core-plugin handoff (pasted into your prompt by the orchestrator). Produce: lua/cursor/ui/chat.lua, lua/cursor/ui/util.lua. The chat UI must: (1) open a layout per config.ui.layout (vsplit | float | tab); (2) render a transcript buffer (read-only, filetype 'markdown', wrap on) and a separate prompt buffer below where the user types and submits with <CR> in normal mode or <C-CR> in insert; (3) wire to require('cursor.agent').start({prompt, on_chunk, on_done, on_error}) and append streamed text to the transcript via vim.schedule; (4) provide a :CursorChat-callable function require('cursor.ui.chat').open() that init.lua's chat() function delegates to; (5) handle close/reopen idempotently and clean up jobs on BufWipeout. Do NOT modify lua/cursor/init.lua, agent.lua, plugin/cursor.lua, or anything outside lua/cursor/ui/. The init.lua in core-plugin already wires chat() through to require('cursor.ui.chat').open(); your job is to provide that module. Push to your own branch.
acceptance: require('cursor.ui.chat').open() opens a transcript + prompt window pair without error
Submitting from the prompt window calls cursor.agent.start and appends streamed chunks to the transcript
BufWipeout on either buffer cancels the in-flight job and tears down state

tasks.name: tests-and-ci
tasks.scopedGoal: Add lint + test infrastructure for cursor.nvim. Read IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md before touching anything. Produce: lua/cursor/_spec/init_spec.lua (plenary busted-style, tests config merge, command registration, agent.lua start/stop with a fake cmd that just `cat`s a canned stream-json file), lua/cursor/_spec/health_spec.lua, .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs on push and pull_request and: (a) installs Neovim 0.10+, stylua, luacheck; (b) runs stylua --check, luacheck lua/ plugin/; (c) clones plenary.nvim and runs PlenaryBustedDirectory on lua/cursor/_spec/. Add a `make test` and `make lint` target via Makefile. Do NOT modify any production Lua files; you depend on core-plugin's interface but should write tests against the public surface (require('cursor').setup, :CursorAsk command exists, agent.start/stop). If the agent module's interface as documented in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md needs an extra hook for testing (e.g. injectable cmd), call that out in suggested follow-ups instead of modifying agent.lua directly.
acceptance: lua/cursor/_spec/init_spec.lua and health_spec.lua exist with at least one assertion each
.github/workflows/ci.yml runs stylua + luacheck + plenary on push and pull_request to main
Makefile has lint and test targets that mirror CI

tasks.name: merge-v0-1
tasks.scopedGoal: Merge orch/cursor-nvim/core-plugin, orch/cursor-nvim/chat-ui, and orch/cursor-nvim/tests-and-ci into the current branch (which starts from orch/cursor-nvim/core-plugin per startingRef). The three workers' pathsAllowed are disjoint, so no conflicts are expected; if any conflict surfaces, prefer the feature owner's version (chat-ui owns lua/cursor/ui/**, tests-and-ci owns lua/cursor/_spec/** and .github/**, core-plugin owns the rest). After merging, run stylua --check lua/ plugin/ and luacheck lua/ plugin/ and report results. Make any small whitespace-only fixes needed to make stylua pass (do NOT modify logic). Open a draft PR against main with title 'cursor.nvim v0.1' and a body that links to IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and lists each acceptance criterion checkbox-style.
acceptance: Single branch contains lua/cursor/init.lua, lua/cursor/agent.lua, lua/cursor/health.lua, lua/cursor/config.lua, lua/cursor/ui/chat.lua, lua/cursor/_spec/*, plugin/cursor.lua, doc/cursor.txt, README.md, .github/workflows/ci.yml, Makefile

tasks.name: verify-v0-1
tasks.scopedGoal: Verify the merged cursor.nvim v0.1 deliverable against IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md acceptance criteria. Install Neovim 0.10+, stylua, luacheck, plenary.nvim. Run: (1) nvim --headless -c "set rtp+=$(pwd)" -c "lua require('cursor').setup({})" -c "q" — must succeed silently; (2) :checkhealth cursor in headless mode, capture output, confirm it has cursor: lines and reports cursor-agent presence; (3) stylua --check; (4) luacheck; (5) PlenaryBustedDirectory on lua/cursor/_spec/.
